title: env.yml
description: Environmental configuration: where the bot runs, what the App slug is, what the canonical classifier publisher is.

runner_tier.description: Where the bot's cron tick runs. T1=GitHub Actions Free, T2=self-hosted, T3=paid cloud Actions.

classifier_publisher_slug.description: The GitHub App slug expected to publish 'classifier-judgment' check-runs. Default 'github-actions' is the GitHub-default runner App; only change if you publish from a different App.

allow_no_ci.description: If true, a PR whose head has zero check-runs passes C2 (CI-green) vacuously, so a repo with no CI can still auto-merge. Default false = fail-closed (no CI signal blocks the merge).

required_checks.description: Global default: named CI check-runs that MUST each be present on the PR head and conclude success for C2 (and L2 post-merge) to pass. A missing required check FAILS C2 regardless of allow_no_ci (which only applies when this list is empty). Per-repo override: projects.yml repo_overrides[<owner/name>].required_checks. Default [] = today's behavior (every completed check must succeed).

expected_check_publisher.description: Global default for C2 publisher trust: the GitHub App slug that must have published a required check-run for it to count as green. A same-named green run from any other App is treated as 'not yet green' (fail closed). Unset = 'github-actions' (the GitHub-default runner App). Per-repo override: projects.yml repo_overrides[<owner/name>].expected_check_publisher.

auto_revert_pr.description: L2 auto-revert PR (opt-in). If true, when post-merge re-validation finds a REAL failure on main, the bot ALSO opens a revert PR (branch revert/<bad-sha7>) in the supervised repo and links it in the incident issue. The revert PR still passes through the normal merge gate (it is NOT auto-labelled ready-to-merge). Default false = detection + incident only (the bot does not author commits in a supervised repo). Any clone/revert/push/PR failure degrades gracefully to incident-only. See docs/decisions/0002_auto_revert_pr.md.

l4_burn_in_days.description: L4 60-day burn-in auto-promotion (opt-in). 0 = off (the registry gate validator_agent_registry stays advisory P2; promote manually via skills.severity_overrides). A positive integer N arms the burn-in clock: N days after the feature is first active, validator_agent_registry is promoted to a hard block (P0) automatically — UNLESS the operator set an explicit skills.severity_overrides entry for it (explicit config always wins, in either direction). The doctrine window is 60. See docs/decisions/0003_l4_burn_in.md.

bot_app_slug.description: Slug of the GitHub App this bot authenticates as. Used by the classifier_bot_self_repo rule and by L1 verifications.
